name: Creality K2
limits_source: https://www.creality.com/products/k2-series-3d-printer (compare table: 300 C nozzle, 100 C bed, no chamber heating)

bed_surface.type: PEI double-sided frosted (textured) flexible plate, 270 x 293 mm
bed_surface.clean: Hand sweat is the first cause Creality lists: wash the plate with dish soap and water; wash built-up glue off with water; then a thin layer of the included glue stick.

auto_level: strain gauge in the hotbed, Smart Auto Leveling (probes only where the model prints)
multi_material: CFS (1 in the Combo, up to 4)

camera.where: chamber camera on the right frame, inside the chamber (720p)
camera.assumption: position and field of view estimated from the owner's IR frame; Creality says only 'right frame'. IR night view seen in the owner's frame.

quirks.note: Creality lists hand sweat on the platform first for a first layer that will not stick, then leveling, a cold bed, filament left on the nozzle (bad Z homing) and the strain gauge.
Creality's K2 Plus guide: a model that detaches clumps on the hotend; keep the bed clean, match the slice to the filament, raise the bed 10 C below 15 C room.

connect.notes: Klipper with Moonraker underneath; the chamber camera is WebRTC (the fleet relays it through go2rtc).
